title: Passwordless login with magic links
description: Many customers forget passwords. Let them sign in with a link sent by email.

comments.author: Priya Nair
comments.body: Chose email magic links because most customers already use email and there is no per-message cost.

comments.author: Priya Nair
comments.body: We rejected SMS codes because of the cost per message and the risk of SIM-swap attacks.

comments.author: Priya Nair
comments.body: Gotcha: some corporate email scanners open links automatically, which used up the one-time token before the customer clicked. The link now opens a confirmation page and the token is only used when the customer presses a button.
